hack.root_cause: Infinite Mint via Fee-on-Transfer Reward Accounting Bug
hack.description: SafeDollar's reward contract didn't account for PLX's transfer fee, letting an attacker loop deposits and withdrawals 101 times to inflate SDO rewards to quadrillions — crashing the "stable" coin to $0.
